title: Fixed Canister Hose and Floor Nozzle Vacuum
description: One original complete static commercial canister-vacuum appearance. A low faceted cylindrical collection-body exterior on four caster wheels carries a stepped top motor cap, complete open carry handle and two side retention latches. One continuous thick curved hose exterior joins its front socket to the top of a full rigid sloping wand, which reaches a separate wide flattened grounded floor nozzle with an actual shallow underside recess. Three opaque untextured PBR roles. Entire new assembly, not the tall pleated-filter and lower-bag workshop dust collector scaled down, and not a backpack sprayer relabelled. One prop and zero scenes. Fixed exterior visual only; no interior air circuit, active suction, dust filtration, electrical operation, health protection, cleaning instructions, wheel travel, mechanical load or safety claim.
